thread:
katie-sales: Heads up — HelixPay procurement needs SOC2 attestation, an ISO excerpt, and a signed pen-test letter by Friday. They also want staging IPs for an external scan and a rough delta on Dedicated pricing for data residency. can we assemble?

devin-security: We can package SOC2 PDF + control matrix. Pen-test letter is a legal doc (template exists). staging IPs ok if scan is scoped to staging subnet. need customer CIDR and whether they want presigned artifacts or SFTP.

katie-sales: They sent 52.14.32.0/24 for the scanner. Procurement asked for presigned download and a one-page pen-test confirmation they can attach to the procurement file. timeline is tight — Friday EOD.

miguel-ops: We can create a presigned S3 bundle and a temporary IP allowlist for that CIDR. presigned link TTL 24h by default. If they need longer, we'll rotate keys. Also tagging: moving to Dedicated will add a monthly commit. ballpark +$7.5k/mo, onboarding one-off ~$2k. I'll confirm exact quote with finance.

legal-jane: I can draft the pen-test letter. quick clarifying Q: Procurement expects a signed letter from our CISO or a delegated signatory? If CISO, I need to route for approval which might add a day. If delegated signatory is acceptable we can get it today.

katie-sales: Procurement prefers CISO but said delegated ok for the POC. please include the standard liability clause and a placeholder for redlines.

devin-security: I'll produce: SOC2.pdf, control-matrix.csv, and a short KMS separation note (screenshot + key policy excerpt). I'll also include a concise runbook for the external scan: requirements, allowed scope, and contact.

deploy-bot: Generated presigned URL: https://s3.redwood.internal/presign/helixpay_artifacts_3100000000.zip?X-Amz-Expires=86400 (expires in 24h) :link:

katie-sales: Perfect, please add the presigned into the email to procurement and cc legal. procurement will also ask about dedicated pricing impact on SLA — Miguel can you add the rough numbers in the email? :thumbsup:

miguel-ops: Will do. Quick note on pricing: if they want single-tenant for EU residency + dedicated autoscale, the delta is closer to +$9k/mo for the initial tier. I'll attach a one-pager with options (shared vs reserved vs private).

legal-jane: Drafted pen-test letter and uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/helixpay/pen-test-draft.docx. Marked as DRAFT with delegated signatory option. If they insist on CISO sign-off, ETA +24h.

devin-security: Scan runbook (short):
```
scan_scope: 52.14.32.0/24
auth: presigned-token (rotates daily)
contact: security@redwood.com
allowed_time_window: 09:00-17:00 UTC
```

katie-sales: This is great. I'll send procurement the bundle now and flag that CISO may be needed for final signature. If legal needs anything else to speed CISO sign-off, ping me. Thanks everyone.

legal-jane: ping me any procurement redlines immediately. I'll prioritize.

miguel-ops: confirming pricing doc + SOW snapshot in 2h.

devin-security: packaging artifacts now, ETA ~2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
